content.bridge_context: Learning to draw geometric shapes accurately using tools like a compass and ruler.

units.title: Using Geometry Tools
units.explanation: Ruler for straight lines, Compass for circles and arcs, Protractor for angles.
units.dual_language_instruction: Draw a 6cm line using a ruler. / रूलर का उपयोग करके 6 सेमी की रेखा खींचें।

units.title: What is a Tiling?
units.explanation: Tiling (or tessellation) is covering a surface with shapes without any gaps or overlaps.
units.dual_language_instruction: Notice the floor tiles in your house. / अपने घर के फर्श की टाइलों पर ध्यान दें।
